title: Approval Required email of a no-charge estimate shows no amounts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login and email the tester can use.
  • Have a new No Charge work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, category Warranty, in Estimate, with one approved labor line of 2.0 hours, with Not in ShopView as its original.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Send to Portal.
  3. Open the "Approval Required" email in the contact's mailbox.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The estimate is sent.

Step 3:

  • The email shows no amounts or totals, and shows the NO CHARGE stamp with "Category: Warranty" ("Not in ShopView" is not shown).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12296 (Story 12 (portal), The no-charge line in the customer portal)

  • S2-R11: “Parts ordering, receiving, picking, clock-ins, approvals, notes, inspections, split and review work exactly as on a billable work order. On an internal work order "Send to Portal" and "Request IBS Approval" are not shown. On a no-charge work order "Send to Portal" works for the estimate as today (the document carries NO CHARGE; the portal estimate shows lines, hours and part quantities on its line cards (on no-charge estimates only; billable cards stay as today) with no prices, no cost and no total, the NO CHARGE stamp and the category line of S2-R16, and Approve and Decline work as today) and is not shown once the work order is closed; "Request IBS Approval" is not shown. The "Approval Required" email follows the page: on a no-charge estimate no amounts or totals, the stamp and the category line instead; on a billable estimate a no-charge line at $0.00 with its category.”
  • S2-R16: “A no-charge work order always carries one category from the No Charge list, set at creation (S2-R2) or at conversion (S2-R5) and editable with Change category (S2-R6) until Close. It shows in the Change category dialog, on the NO CHARGE document and the estimate under the masthead ("Category: Warranty", with "· Original work order S2-30455" only when the original is a real work order, never "Not in ShopView"), in the notes and the audit log, in the Internal Work Orders report (S9-R2), in the Customer Invoice export (S9-R6), in the hub record (S8-R1) and in the Open API (S2-R12). It is not shown on the work order detail or in lists; the badge is the only mark there. The category decides the account the parts cost posts to (Stories 5 to 8). Internal work orders carry an Internal category resolved by S2-R1.”
